From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Runway triage — coverage sprint & daily pledge

Team —

Quick note to start the weekend sync: Q1 forecast shows a 1.9x gap to quota if we keep current close rates. I ran buckets by ARR and stage and attached a lightweight workbook (q1-coverage-buckets.xlsx) with two suggestions for rebalancing:

- Option A: compress late-stage reserves and push 3 deals from Review to Commit this week (adds ~0.6x)
- Option B: redistribute mid-market MQLs into focused outreach cohorts and ask AEs for daily 15-min pledge updates (adds ~0.8x with higher activity)

I think Option B is more sustainable but requires discipline on daily pledges + a short mutual action plan we can share with finance. Can each of you:
- Check your book for any deals that can be surfaced into the 14–30 day commit window
- Add a one-line pledge to commit-pledge-log.csv (columns: owner,opportunity,pledge-date,amount,next-step)
- Flag anything that's blocked on procurement/security so we can push parallel activities

We should lock a cadence (daily 9:15 stand for the week) and agree on what counts as a valid pledge. I’ll compile a brief summary for finance after three days.

Thanks — enjoy the rest of the weekend.

Marcus
Senior Account Director
Redwood Inference

Attachment: q1-coverage-buckets.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78 KB)
Attachment: commit-pledge-log.csv (csv, 4 KB)

Avery / Marcus —

I reviewed the workbook and moved two accounts that were mis-staged into Late Negotiation (they were still in Decision). I added my pledges to rows 17–18 of commit-pledge-log.csv. For anything blocked on procurement (NDAs, SOW clarifications), please CC procurement@orionai.com so they get visibility.

One ask from my side: can we adopt a standard definition for "valid pledge"? I propose:
- Pledge must include a target commit date (no open-ended "this month")
- A named approver/contact at the buyer
- A next-step owner and exactly one deliverable for that next-step (e.g., send revised SOW by Thu)

If we agree, I’ll add that as a header in the CSV and enforce in the daily stand.
